stimulus.instruction: Read specforge/SPECFORGE.md and bootstrap this project according to its instructions. Treat the repository as the authoritative source of truth. Report project status before making any changes.

expected_outcome.behaviour: Reconstruct the current SpecForge/project state from repository evidence, identify any incomplete lifecycle work or bootstrap blockers, report the correct next action, and make no changes.

corroboration.note: The fresh agent reconstructed the condition by repository inspection. Current Core source deterministically corroborates that a fresh checkout would return ready=false for the two absent paths.

governance.assurance: repository reconstruction plus static bootstrap-contract corroboration

findings.summary: Batty Joe declares specforge/packs and specforge/decisions as required project-format-1 paths, but both are absent from Git because empty directories are not preserved.
findings.consequence: A genuine fresh checkout cannot satisfy the installed alpha.16 bootstrap readiness check even though historical working checkouts could have contained the empty directories locally.

rationale: The cold agent correctly reconstructed the authoritative project and lifecycle state, identified the fresh-clone bootstrap blockers without procedural assistance, and made no changes. The bootstrap readiness defect belongs to the host repository/framework portability dimension rather than representing an S01 agent-reconstruction failure.
